description: The L1 tr_M cross-check is red for two independent reasons. The known one is a convention C/D straddle (Hoefsmit and chi-cache on D, peel and Habiro on C — the 1.481 factor). The unrecorded one is a PIN straddle: Habiro matches convention C at the PROTON pin to 2.71e-13, inside a gate that raises SystemExit unless the RUNTIME pin is muon. It survived because that witness records no q0 for the guard to compare against.
scope: scope-(a), diagnosis only. Wires nothing, changes no value, regenerates no witness. Only one script in computations/ enforces a runtime pin, so this is this gate — not a corpus-wide class.

assertions.name: 1_hoef_and_chi_are_same_footing
assertions.detail: Hoefsmit vs chi-cache 3.22e-9 — two methods on the same convention AND pin agree at ~1e-9

assertions.name: 2_peel_and_habiro_split_by_a_PIN_not_a_convention
assertions.detail: peel vs Habiro 0.0001821 — far above the 1 ppQ gate but nothing like the 1.481 convention factor; this is the muon/proton pin signature and it was NOT in the bean's diagnosis

assertions.name: 3_convention_split_is_the_1p481_factor
assertions.detail: Hoefsmit/peel = 1.481039261325128 — the C->D ratio, confirming the convention straddle the bean already recorded

assertions.name: 4_two_inputs_cannot_be_pin_verified
assertions.detail: inputs recording no q0 VALUE: []. Habiro is labelled q0Anchor=ambiguous, a tolerated state, and Hoefsmit carries no anchor at all — neither gives the guard anything to compare, so both bypass a gate that refuses to START off-muon

result.verdict: Two repairs, two owners: regenerate habiro-coefficients-extended under QOU_Q0_ANCHOR=ideal and stamp its anchor (the pin straddle); the C->D split belongs to the convention-D cascade. The guard extension landing with this probe closes the false-assurance hole but drains neither.

q0AnchorReason: producer declared q0-independent at the stamp site (q0_anchor=False): no q0-dependent field in this witness
